gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-kumbh-sans: Wide-set letters with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning give Bruno Ace SC its whole personality. Kumbh Sans underneath keeps its terminals cut short and its strokes fixed-pen steady.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-libre-franklin: Spaced-out, open display lettering: Bruno Ace SC shows no difference between its upright and sideways strokes. Bruno Ace SC grabs attention up top; Libre Franklin does the steady carrying below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-1: M PLUS 1 reads with wide-open eyes in its letters and the flat, steady line of a fineliner. And Bruno Ace SC supplies the standout quality, a wide-set display look with every aperture open.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-2: Bruno Ace SC spreads wide, open-apertured letters across the heading with no calligraphic thinning at all. And M PLUS 2 follows with a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mandali: Skeleton-outline strokes at one fixed thickness give Bruno Ace SC its look. Mandali is approachable and clean, with a generous entry into the e's eye, so paragraphs of text move along gently.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-meera-inimai: Bruno Ace SC does display attitude best, wide-set with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning. Meera Inimai does text best, with open-ended curves that have room to breathe and a blueprint-lettering feel.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mina: Spaced-out, unshaded display letters: Bruno Ace SC keeps every aperture open. Mina draws strokes as plain as a stitched outline, and a generously unclosed curve on each small round letter keeps paragraphs flowing smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-moderustic: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC shows a drawn-with-one-width stroke, spread-out letters, and open apertures throughout. Moderustic's sans curves, traced broad-nib and left unfinished, make running text feel loose.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-molengo: One-nib confidence, spread wide: Bruno Ace SC keeps every aperture open and never thins a stroke. Molengo, a contemporary sans with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, handles the quieter text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-momo-trust-sans: Bruno Ace SC stretches its letters wide, with open apertures and one steady stroke width throughout. And Momo Trust Sans brings the friendliest quality, with bowls as sturdy as its stems and unclosed mouths.
